title: no rubric criterion gates on zero Rust compiler warnings
description: cargo test and cargo build emit Rust compiler warnings (e.g. dead_code: field `optional` is never read at src/domain/spec_schema.rs:14:16) but no rubric criterion requires zero warnings as a pass condition. The no-dead-code criterion in assets/run.rubrics.md concerns spec-mandated item removals, not compiler lints. The all-tests-pass and binary-builds criteria only gate on exit code (zero failures/errors), not on clean output. Warnings therefore accumulate silently across runs with no signal path.
proposed_resolution: Add a zero-compiler-warnings rubric criterion (global baseline or project run baseline) that requires cargo build --release 2>&1 | grep -E '^warning:' to produce zero output, or treat warnings as errors via RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings. Existing warnings (e.g. FrontmatterSchema.optional) must be resolved or suppressed with #[allow(dead_code)] before the criterion can be adopted.
